steps.label: Staging Area
steps.sub: Marked with git add, ready to commit

code:
git init

git add report.py     # stage one file
git add .              # stage everything changed
caption: init creates the hidden .git folder; add chooses exactly what goes into the next commit.

code:
git commit -m "Add quarterly totals to report"

git status
git log

# commit a1b2c3d4e5f6...
# Author: Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>
#     Add quarterly totals to report
caption: A good message says what changed and why — "fix bug" tells future-you nothing.
